title: EASY ARMS & GENTLE CORE
subtitle: FRIDAY EASE. LIGHT ARMS. SOFT CORE.

script.welcome: Hello Pam. I'm Stratton. Friday is easy arms and a soft bit of core — a small break from the desk, nothing fierce. About eleven minutes. If a joint is sore, take a smaller range. Showing up is the win.
script.start: Whenever you're ready. Easy breath. This is meant to feel doable.
script.nextExercise: Next one. Shake it out if you like. No rush.
script.rest: Have a little rest. Breathe easy.
script.lastSet: Last set. Make it comfortable and clean.
script.complete: That's us. Lovely work. Light arms, a gentle core, and you showed up. Enjoy your day — see you tomorrow.
script.resume: Back with you. Easy as we go.

exercises.name: WALL PUSH-UPS
exercises.cue: Hands on the wall at shoulder height, feet a comfortable step back. Keep a long straight line from head to heels. Softly bring the chest toward the wall, then press away. Standing only — no floor. Smaller range is fine on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Wall push ups. Two sets of six. Hands on the wall, long straight body, chest in and press away. Stay on your feet. Keep it easy.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty five seconds. Shake the arms. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Wall push ups done. Nicely done.

exercises.name: SEATED OVERHEAD PRESS
exercises.cue: Sit tall. Light weights or empty hands at shoulder height. Press gently overhead only as far as feels kind, then lower with control. Soft ribs, soft neck. Smaller range is fine on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated overhead press. Two sets of eight. Sit tall, press softly overhead only as far as feels kind, then lower with control. Easy on the shoulders.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty five seconds. Stay seated. Soften the shoulders.

exercises.name: SEATED ROW
exercises.cue: Sit tall. Light weights or empty hands. Draw elbows back as if rowing, squeeze the shoulder blades gently, then release. Soft on the neck. Stay seated the whole way. Smaller range is fine on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated row. Two sets of eight. Sit tall, draw the elbows back softly, squeeze the shoulder blades, then release. Easy on the neck.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty five seconds. Stay seated. Easy breath.

exercises.name: SEATED KNEE LIFTS
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair. Soft belly. Lift one knee gently, then lower with control. Alternate sides. Soft ankle, soft hip — only a comfortable height. This is your gentle core. Smaller lift is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated knee lifts for a soft core. Two sets of eight per leg. Sit tall, soft belly, lift one knee gently, lower with control. Alternate. Keep it easy.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Stay seated. Soften the hips.
exercises.speakDone: Knee lifts done. That's the session — lovely work.
